result: Static start reads program headers with one bit test each (startup_instr_c 2191 CI red -> 2108, limit 2161, notes kept); the window-bin planner breaks head-bin ties away from phase-only groups so a start file pad no longer gives the rebind phase a fault
informational: Window-bin planner, latent: the head bin is not aligned at its start, so text ahead of the group beyond HEAD_ROOM (1 KiB) pushes a suffix of bin 0 into its own window; a phase-only section there with no warm-up section after it is the phase's first touch of that window. The tie-break fixes every case with an equal-cost later bin; the fast plan's two float-phase sections (printf Env::text, conv::printf_text) have none and stay in that tail (reachable only by a pre pad of most of a window; float is not in the text-phase test).
